en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a busy wooden quay or pier with many men in early‑20th‑century clothing, some in uniform, walking in a line toward or from a gangway. In the background there is a rail yard with freight cars and a passenger coach, and low wooden town buildings behind the tracks. Handwritten text at the top identifies the scene and date, and a catalog number is written at the bottom.
